name: use-current-user-needs-auth-header
body: useCurrentUser's fetch to /api/users/me must send the JWT token as Authorization: JWT <token> header, not just the cookie. Payload's /api/users/me endpoint validates the token via the Authorization header, not just credentials: 'include'. The server-side getMeUser reads the token and sends it as Authorization header - the client-side hook must do the same.
why: Without the Authorization header, Payload returns null user even when the payload-token cookie is present, causing authenticated users to see 'Log in to Buy' instead of checkout.
